paragraphs.source_en: A neutron from the original U-235 fission impacts another nucleus. This causes it to fission in turn, and a chain reaction of further collisions begins. If the reaction sustains itself it is called "critical" and the mass of U-235 is said to be a "critical mass."

This causes it to fission in turn, and a chain reaction of further collisions begins.
